aspect: Registering is the condition and the risk
description: The programme requires handing over address, biometrics and family details, which is protective while the programme exists and is a locator list if it ends.
energy_note: The application is also a map to his front door.

aspect: Litigation means the future is decided elsewhere
description: Whether he can work next year is determined by appellate courts in cases he is not a party to and cannot influence.
energy_note: His life, on a docket he is not named in.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the news alert at work
description: He is on a ladder when his phone buzzes. A court has ruled. He reads it twice, then keeps working, because there is nothing else to do with the information and the job finishes Thursday.
energy_note: Reads it twice, and carries on plastering.
